intro.text: You wake up at the entrance of an ancient dungeon. You hold an old torch in your hand. Two paths lie ahead: one leads into a dark tunnel, the other leads up an illuminated staircase.

dark_tunnel.text: You descend into the shadows and hear a rustling sound. A wild goblin emerges from the darkness!

staircase.text: The staircase leads to a locked chest. A health potion lies on top!

choices.text: Take the potion and return to the fork

win_goblin.text: You have triumphed over the goblin and found the way out of the dungeon! Congratulations, you have completed the demo version!
